generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, the three skills run as one flow each time you search. You plan the search around the claim you need, build keywords such as 'adolescent' with its synonyms, then combine and refine them in the discovery service. Running them together finds the right studies faster than typing a question into the box.
generatedProse.worked-example: Two psychology students need sources on whether social media affects adolescents' sleep. Tom types the whole question into the service and takes the first results, with no plan and no keyword set. Amara plans first, builds keywords such as 'social media' and 'adolescent' with synonyms, then combines and refines them with operators and a date limiter. Running the three skills as one strategy, Amara finds focused, recent studies in less time.
generatedProse.summary: In psychology, searching works best when the three skills run as one strategy. You plan around the claim you need, build keywords and synonyms for each concept, then combine and refine them in the service, reusing that flow for every search. It is the whole strategy that reaches the right studies.

check.body: A student plans a search, builds keywords with synonyms, then combines and refines them in the discovery service, and finds strong sources quickly. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.
Only the mark on the first report, which cannot now change.
The deadline for the next report.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next report, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next report improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: That the three skills work as one strategy: the plan, the keywords and the refined search together found good sources.
_items.feedback: Yes. Each step set up the next, and together they found strong sources.

_items.text: That only the discovery service mattered, and the plan and keywords did not.
_items.feedback: The discovery service worked because the plan and keywords prepared it. All three mattered.

_items.text: That the student was lucky, since good sources come mainly by chance.
_items.feedback: Good sources came from the strategy, not luck: plan, keywords, then a refined search.

_items.text: That planning alone was enough, and the keywords and search added nothing.
_items.feedback: Planning started it, but the keywords and the refined search did the finding too.
